newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Two killed in Colombian indigenous protest.
newsitem.headline: Two killed in Colombian indigenous protest.

text.p: A soldier shot and killed two members of Colombia's indigenous Guambiano community on Thursday on the second day of a mass protest on the Pan American Highway in the southwestern province of Cauca, authorities said.
A police spokesman called the shooting "accidental" but said it would be investigated by military authorities.
Details of the incident were not immediately available.
The victims, males aged 16 and 40, were among about 3,500 Guambianos and rural farmers who had assembled along the busy highway near the city of Popayan to press for land and water rights.
The army had been sent to maintain public order, the police spokesman said.
